title: The Ancestor's Shield
text: A shield hangs over a barrow's door, its paint flaking, its rim black with age. It bears a House's arms. Your own House's arms, painted by someone who died before your founders were born. Beneath it the barrow breathes out a cold, patient air.

options.label: Take it down, by right of blood.

outcomes.text: It comes down easily, as if it had been waiting. It is yours. It always was.
The ancestor disagrees, and comes up out of the barrow to say so.

options.label: Kneel and honor the dead below.

outcomes.text: The cold air warms a little. Something in the barrow is proud of you.

options.label: The wisest reads the barrow's runes.

outcomes.text: The runes name a forgotten branch of the House, and how it ended. Nobody tells the others how.
